items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: I remember seeing Clara Bow and Harry Richman. They were big stars...

ctx.x: I think it was like a quarter at some time, or .50¢.

Well, I suppose something like that, but Connie's Inn was a different bracket entirely, you know. Most of the people who came to Connie's Inn came from downtown, you know. I remember seeing Clara Bow and Harry Richman. They were big stars, and nightclub stars and movie stars, and they came up their in an aluminum-bodied Rolls Royce. And this was the Depression, Depression for some people. Well, no Depression for the --
